_comment: Copy to config.local.json (not shipped) and edit. Env vars MAILBOX_ME / MAILBOX_ALIASES / MAILBOX_SELF / MAILBOX_VIEWER_ROOM override these. Missing keys fall back to the defaults shown here.

self._comment: ids: names this install posts as (first = monitor identity). aliases: addresses that count as mail to me. Example: ids ["team-agent"], aliases ["team-agent", "agent"].

_saver_view_comment: Optional (personal saver hook only; safe to delete). External quota-saver hook's snapshot file (not shipped here). Missing file: the saver chip/advice line just don't show.
_launchd_comment: Prefix for launchd job labels used by the scripts, e.g. <prefix>.viewer. launchd_labels: full label per job, overrides the prefix ("" = use the prefix).
_quota_probe_comment: true = while the usage API returns 429, send one paid Haiku call (max_tokens 1, about $0.00002) every 120s to read the credit ratio from response headers. Off by default. Env SIDEREUS_QUOTA_PROBE=1/0 overrides.
_security_comment: quota_lookup: false = never read the Claude Code OAuth token from the keychain and never call api.anthropic.com (quota cards go blank). keep_awake: false = never hold caffeinate. See SECURITY.md.
_prefs_comment: Also editable in the viewer (설정 > 내 방식); applied after a restart. saver_hook_dir (optional, personal saver hook only; safe to delete): folder of .saver-force.json/.saver-goal.json. compact_history: [["YYYY-MM-DD", autoCompactWindow or null], ...] ascending, [] = no history (current setting only).
_port_comment: Viewer port (1024..65535; also 설정 > 내 방식 «포트»). Env SIDEREUS_PORT overrides; `sidereus_cli.py start --port N` writes it here. Hooks, MCP and saver read the same value. Applies after a restart.
_features_comment: Optional features (features/<id>.json manifests, docs/dev/FEATURES.md): {id: true|false}. A missing id is on; a feature whose dep is off is off too. Public default = core only. Applied after a restart.
